highlights:
After updating, sign in to websites again in Nod's browser. This release replaces the old saved browser sessions.

## Answers you can use

Nod can now show lists, schedules, comparisons and message drafts as cards. Open a row for its details. Select an option to reply, or type your own answer. Lists of places can include a map. Draft messages show their recipients and text before you send them.

Try asking: “Compare three places for our team lunch.”

## New architecture: one browser for your work

Nod now uses one browser that keeps your website sign-ins. Each chat, task and scheduled run gets its own tab. Sign in once, then later tasks can use that sign-in. Tabs stay open while their jobs wait for you.

Jobs on the same website share its sign-in and shopping cart.

## Give Nod several jobs

Send several messages while Nod works. Nod reads them together and is guided to answer them in one reply. Separate requests can start separate tasks that run at the same time. Follow-up instructions count when Nod checks permission for the next action.

## Also in this release

- **Models:** New model selections start at medium reasoning effort. A badge marks the recommended model.
- **App connections:** Before sign-in, see how your data travels and which services can read it.
- **Schedules:** A saved schedule keeps its instructions after you stop the request that created it.
- **Sign-in:** Nod asks for the fields needed by the selected sign-in method.
